desc:
March 30, 2011.
Since the tsunami, the gynecology clinics in the prefecture were severely damaged and some of the doctors apparently killed due to the disaster. Thus, for over two weeks the pregnant women of the precinct have not seen or consulted a doctor. 
In accordance to orders given by the GOC
